subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should this release train intentionally ship the breaking `question.*` and session-catalog protocol reshapes for beta/pre-public consumers without retaining a compatibility adapter or versioned contract?
rationale: The patch deliberately removes and renames protocol surface across the SDK, generated native models, extensions, and UI; tests can verify consistency but cannot decide the acceptable compatibility window.

options.title: Approve the cleanup window
options.body: Accept the documented beta/pre-public break after the caller audit and current-head runtime proof are made reviewable.

options.title: Preserve a migration boundary
options.body: Keep or version a narrow compatibility path for any beta or external consumer that must remain supported through this release train.

recommendation.title: Approve the cleanup window
recommendation.body: Accept the documented beta/pre-public break after the caller audit and current-head runtime proof are made reviewable.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent staged commits and PR rationale make this contributor the clearest available routing candidate for the intended protocol-release direction.
